name: Naturopathic Medicine Indigenous Student Scholarship (SCU)
summary: Up to $2,500 for Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander students in SCU's health and lifestyle or naturopathic medicine courses.
key: The successful recipient can receive funding up to $2,500.
who: Identify as an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled in the Bachelor of Health Science (Health and Lifestyle) or Master of Naturopathic Medicine.
how: Apply through the National Centre for Naturopathic Medicine Scholarship Application Form.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Naturopathic Medicine Indigenous Student Scholarship

evidence.quote: the successful recipient can receive funding up to $2,500
Applications for this scholarship are open until Friday 18 December 2026.
